title: Handle directory symlinks in quality harness

acceptance.text: Directory symlinks do not crash quality diff scanning and retain Git symlink identity.
Symlink changes remain subject to ownership, fingerprint and risk checks without reading targets.

spec.expected_behavior: Scan symlinks using their link content without following targets.
spec.observed_behavior: Scanning a changed symlink to a directory throws EISDIR.

red_targets.test: scanDiff > tracks directory and dangling symlinks without following their targets
red_targets.expect: directory symlink must scan without error
